policy.policy: All forced defenses; all one-move-loss escape points when at most nine; otherwise nine-PV engine screening with a 220-score / six-ply mate band, preserving prior viable choices. Terminal examples when no escape exists.

rootRefinement.policy: Refine each of nine root candidates with an independent black search; use the shorter reported mate bound before applying the same six-ply band.

policy.tempoFourPolicy: Omit a nonessential white four only when the identical full recorded continuation remains legal and wins with and without its forced white-four/black-block exchange. Preserve forced defenses. Replace all-redundant menus with the shortest verified suffix, including singleton and chained exchanges; audit grafted menus against that recorded strategy.
policy.oppositeFourThreePolicy: When Black has multiple legal next-move four-three attacks and no immediate five, cover every attack with a direct White block. Retain existing choices; add blocks of uncovered attacks, each followed by a fixed legal four-three at another point without an immediate White win. At most nine choices, prioritizing occupation of attack points and coverage of every side before additional nearby blocks.
